name: Adjia Technologies Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2015, Adjia Technologies Ltd is exclusively engaged in the AMC Business of Servicing of IT Components.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
ATL specializes in immersive technologies like Augmented Reality (AR), Virtual Reality (VR), and 360° content solutions to various customers electronically, along with other software consultancy services. These technologies are used in key sectors such as education, real estate, tourism, healthcare, manufacturing, retail, and entertainment

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 0.45% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 563 days.
